Done. All three functions have been implemented and exported:

1. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
2. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — converts titles to slugs by lowercasing, trimming, replacing spaces with dashes, and stripping non-alphanumeric characters
3. **`fetchUsers(baseUrl)`** in src/api.js — fetches the user array from the API endpoint, logs the count, and returns the parsed JSON
